text: I've always had my dental work done here. It's more expensive than other places, that's fine, but manners are important in the workplace. Even if you don't know, gossiping about customers behind their backs shouldn't be ignored. To be blunt, I eat rice, not grass. Even if you're just a dentist's assistant, your mouth doesn't need to be so foul. Your teeth are fine; you haven't had scaling done in years and you don't have cavities. That's your business, I'm happy for you. Keep all your teeth until you're old, just in case you get punched in the mouth before you die. Thank you.
